title: main whose only statement is an else-less false if fails
purpose: An entry result that is not an actual int must be rejected or fail.

failure.justification: The contract requires failure but does not fix the detection stage: spec 6.3 allows a static pass to diagnose result-type mismatches before execution, otherwise the runtime boundary check fails.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 3 + 7.2: `if false { 1; }` yields no value; missing results MUST fail rather than default to 0.
